summary: Verified CHANGE #1 (Instagram-style nickname validation, backend + frontend) and CHANGE #2 (ShareSheet OS-native Share.share() with paste-guide fallback). All 8 backend nickname pytest cases pass (anonymous rejects space/emoji/hyphen, accepts test.user_1, strips leading @; profile PATCH rejects 'has space' with Italian message, accepts chat_a, accepts chat.a_2 then resets). All 4 frontend nickname sanitize tests pass across auth-anon-nickname-input and edit-nickname-input (spaces / hyphens / leading @ / emoji stripped in real time as user types). ShareSheet behaviour verified end-to-end on desktop web: (A) without navigator.share, tapping share-instagram triggers paste-guide-open + paste-guide-cancel overlay; (B) monkey-patching navigator.share to resolve makes tapping share-instagram invoke it, no paste guide, share sheet auto-closes; (C) AbortError from navigator.share leaves the sheet open with no paste-guide; (D) share-whatsapp still opens the wa.me URL and closes the sheet. Static: ShareSheet.tsx imports Share from react-native and calls Share.share({message,url,title}) inside shareNative helper (line 111). Test credential chat_a nickname confirmed = 'chat_a' at end of run.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py _normalize_and_validate_nickname is shared across signup/anonymous/update_profile — good DRY, error message matches frontend NICKNAME_HINT ('solo lettere, numeri, punti e underscore').
frontend/src/utils/nickname.ts sanitizeNicknameInput drops leading '@' and any non [A-Za-z0-9._] char, plus truncates to NICKNAME_MAX — mirrors backend regex exactly.
ShareSheet.tsx correctly distinguishes AbortError (cancel, no-op) from other failures (paste-guide fallback). Web branch checks typeof navigator.share === 'function' before invoking.
seed_data_creation: None — reused pre-verified chat_a@test.it account. Anonymous accounts created transiently by the validation tests (test.user_1 + Handle_<hex>); not cleaned up but harmless.
